corrections.was: docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2p follow-up 1: 009EEAAB.. is 'the only code that can latch blk+35Ch and form a desired throttle for a ship in Navigate'.
corrections.is: The range is the only code that latches blk+35Ch for a ship in Navigate, and it is the only writer of blk+344h on that path. It does not write blk+1D0h or blk+1D4h at all: the desired throttle and rudder stay whatever the setters left, and 009F3F80 forms the ring command from blk+35Ch, blk+344h and the heading target.
corrections.evidence: no store to +1D0h or +1D4h exists anywhere in 009EEAAB..009EF226; the only float store into blk in the range other than the latch bookkeeping is 009EEF0A MOVSS [ESI+344h],XMM1

corrections.was: docs/UNIT_COMMANDED_SPEED.md reads navigatorParams+21h as the byte luaMW_NavigatorForceMoveCloseToTarget writes.
corrections.is: Correct, and the binding writes the inverse of its argument: 008A359B TEST AL,AL, 008A359D SETE AL, 008A35A4 MOV [ESI+21h],AL. Set on the block it means 'keep clear of traffic', and clearing it through the binding switches the whole setback walk off, which is what the binding name asks for.

uncertainties: x87 intermediates are modelled as double with a float store at each native FSTP. The native uses 80-bit registers between those points, so a value that is exactly representable at neither width can differ in the last bits.

The walk at 009EEB80..009EEEEC has no iteration bound in the image: it leaves only on a clear pass or when the setback reaches blk+330h. The reconstruction adds a 1024-step guard that is not in the native routine and reports the step count.
Entity kind 6 at 009EEBC8 is the argument, not a decoded meaning: vtable[5Ch]'s body was not read and the site tests AL only.
The unit heading behind vtable[50h] at 009EF0D6 is the same provisional reading docs/SHIP_AI_NAVIGATION_ARM.md carries for 009EE8C7.
009DE5B0 at 009EF213 is contract: unread; it is 0B67h bytes and is also one of the writers of blk+3A5h.

blk+3C4h is taken as the reference speed on docs/SHIP_AI_OBSTACLE_TABLES.md's word; blk+3D4h, blk+3D8h and blk+3CCh are read from their producer FUN_009E4330 (009E4537, 009E453F, 009E4568) but that routine as a whole was not projected.
